messages.author: b6fd2925353976cd
messages.subject: Pareto k estimates
parts:
When using loo, I have 0.4% of my Pareto k estimates (2 points) falling between 0.5 and 1, but they are still below 0.7. As far as I understand the Vehtari, Gelman, Gabry 2016 arXiv draft this suggests that I can stay with loo and do not need to do k-fold cross validation. Is this correct?

many thanks,

Shravan Vasishth

messages.author: a236d3d356ca53fd
messages.subject: Re: Pareto k estimates
parts:
Yes, in this case it is likely that the PSIS-LOO error is small. Note that the paper has been published also in Statistics and Computing, doi:10.1007/s11222-016-9696-4

Aki
